name: Landscape Album in Various Styles: The Stream of Wuling
material: album leaf, ink and light color on paper
summary: At age 68, Zha Shibiao painted this album with seasonal landscapes in various styles. Painted in fresh colors and wet strokes, all depict typical scenes of Jiangnan.
